title: Glass Cows
description: Turns the cows into glass, because it's funny and it sounds like Glasgow (The city in Scotland)
body:
**Have you ever wanted your Minecraft cows to be made of glass so you could make a joke about mispelling Glasgow?**

Well I'm here to introduce you to the Glass Cows resource pack, which turns both the cow and the mooshroom into glass. Meaning that you can see right through them, which is somewhat situational, but can be useful in the situations where it could be required.

This texture pack is being updated for every version, and I'm planning on making support for modded cows as well, so the joke can spread to your favourite mods as well.
